patch.summary: Freshsales implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Freshsales by mapping current crm workflows to Freshsales objects, confirming plan gates for email sequences (Pro, Enterprise), forecasting (Enterprise), lead scoring (Pro, Enterprise), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Gmail) after data checks.
bullets: Integrate after: data quality pass on Gmail

blocks.heading: Freshsales day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Freshsales setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for contact management, lead management, pipeline management before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves SMB and mid-market teams wanting CRM + phone/email engagement before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Gmail before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover email sequences (Pro, Enterprise)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Sales sequences, contact scoring, and territory management start on Pro; forecasting insights, custom modules, sandbox, and audit logs are Enterprise.
Do not expand seats until contact management is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Sales sequences, contact scoring, and territory management start on Pro; forecasting insights, custom modules, sandbox, and audit logs are Enterprise.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Branded documents (list price) and Freddy AI Agent (list price/100 sessions) are listed as paid add-ons.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: SEO copy mentions a free plan, but the live pricing cards researched Aug 2026 list Growth/Pro/Enterprise only starting at list price — treat free forever as unverified from plan cards.

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Sequences, scoring, and territories require Pro

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Freshsales plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Growth
lines.description: 21-day trial · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, pipeline management · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Pro
lines.description: 21-day trial · Unlocks: email sequences, lead scoring, territory management · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: 21-day trial · Unlocks: forecasting, audit logs · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.title: Validate crm fit before a deep Freshsales rollout
blocks.body: If Freshsales fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Freshsales object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on contact management
If blocked, evaluate Pipedrive before sunk-cost expansion
